answer: Beacon spot-checks and compute heartbeats block attempts to forge identities. Each agent posts an hourly heartbeat proving work; the registry is tended like a garden, weeding out lapsed plots. The beacon audits 5% each epoch, marking failures umber and slashing a $20 deposit. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 heartbeats at $0.10 per hour: $100 hourly and $20,000 locked. One honest agent pays $2.40 a day and earns rewards undiluted by fakes.
